# IdeaHub standard male — connected boundary

Purpose: compare a connected Idea|Hub boundary against the standard male baseline.

Pronunciation: `[AY0][D][IY1][AH0][HH][AH1][B]`. The CamelCase boundary is represented as `connected`, so there is no explicit separator between the two phone groups.

This run performs pronunciation + TTS only; no augmentation or ASR is run.
